evidence: A landslide at Mawa Khola in Ichchhakamana-3 blocked the Prithvi Highway shortly after the early-morning Ghoptibhir failure.
A separate landslide at Dati Khola in Ichchhakamana-3 blocked the Prithvi Highway.
A separate landslide at Panidhara in Ichchhakamana-3 blocked the Prithvi Highway.
